questions.q: Identify compounds A and E in the following reaction sequence.
questions.explain: Take the sequence step by step. The ring has ethyl (ortho/para director, activating) and NO2 (meta director). Br2/AlBr3 goes ortho to ethyl, which is also meta to NO2, so both groups agree and A has Br next to ethyl. Sn/HCl turns NO2 into NH2, NaNO2/HCl makes the diazonium salt, and ethanol replaces N2+ with H. That leaves 2-bromoethylbenzene. KMnO4/KOH oxidises the benzylic ethyl chain fully to COOH, so E is 2-bromobenzoic acid. Only option B has Br ortho to ethyl and a COOH at the end.
